segments.text: You will see four letters on our technicians' credentials. I I C R C.
It stands for the Institute of Inspection, Cleaning and Restoration Certification.
It certifies restoration technicians against industry standards.
What that means for you is straightforward. The person in your home has been trained and examined, not simply hired.
Restoration done poorly does not look wrong on the day. It looks wrong months later, inside the wall.
That is why the certification matters more than the van or the uniform.
Ask any contractor to show you their technicians' certification. Ask us first.
